basis: Successors to rejected lot-012 candidates S11-P0180-01 and S11-P0180-02, with complete pages 179-181 lineage disclosed per lineage_units.

evidence_candidates.claim: The Article 6(1) product route classifies an AI system as high-risk only when both the Annex I safety-component or product condition (Page 179) and the third-party conformity-assessment condition (Page 180) are met.
qualifiers: The product, or the AI system as a product, must require third-party conformity assessment before market placement or putting into service under Annex I harmonisation law (Page 180).
The first condition is that the AI system is intended to be used as a safety component of a product covered by Annex I legislation, or is itself such a product (Page 179).

evidence_candidates.claim: Beyond the Article 6(1) systems, AI systems listed in Annex III are classified as high-risk (Page 180); a derogation applies where the system poses no significant risk of harm and a listed condition is met, but an Annex III system that profiles natural persons always remains high-risk notwithstanding the derogation (Page 181).
qualifiers: The derogation conditions are listed at Page 180, points a) to d).
The profiling override appears at Page 181, first paragraph.
